newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent quoted down, NYMEX April extends slide.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent quoted down, NYMEX April extends slide.

text.p: Brent crude futures were untraded but quoted lower on Thursday, in line with the weaker tone of NYMEX, where players were moving positions forward out of the front month.
May Brent was quoted on SIMEX at $20.20/$20.32 per barrel after London rose seven cents to $20.32.

London's firm close was sparked by a rally at that time on NYMEX, which rose in New York as high as $22.65. However, after London had closed, New York turned sharply lower as players moved positions forward out of the April contract into May.
April, which expires later on Thursday, closed down two cents at $22.04 in New York.
On ACCESS, it gave up support at $22.00 and last traded during Asia at $21.87, down 17 cents. May on ACCESS was down nine cents at $21.73.
Tom James, regional manager for Credit Lyonnais Rouse natural resources derivatives, said that NYMEX was losing the short-covering support of the last few days now that April is to expire.
He said May could lose 80 cents to $1.00 after April expires.
